title: Cold Chain Principles and Vaccine Handling Basics
subject: Immunization
preview: Many vaccines require controlled temperature monitoring throughout transport and storage.
quickRevision: Many vaccines require controlled temperature monitoring throughout transport and storage.
Record excursions, quarantine potentially affected stock and follow product-specific guidance before reuse.
Stock rotation, validated equipment and clear contingency plans protect potency.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: Many vaccines require controlled temperature monitoring throughout transport and storage.
Freezing can damage certain adsorbed vaccines, while heat and light may affect other products.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not assume a vaccine remains effective merely because the vial looks normal after a cold-chain breach.

quiz.question: What is appropriate after an unassessed cold-chain excursion?
quiz.explanation: Quarantine stock and obtain guidance. Record excursions, quarantine potentially affected stock and follow product-specific guidance before reuse.
